'''Bandosian guards''' are [[ork]]s that appear and attack the player when doing [[coordinate]] steps of [[elite clue scroll]]s. Bandosian guards use only melee attacks, so [[Protect from Melee]] will prevent all damage taken from them. Upon killing the guard, players can dig a second time in the correct location in order to receive the next clue.

On clue scroll steps where the Bandosian guard can appear, alternatively an [[Armadylean guard]] may appear in its place. The lone exceptions are [[Clue scroll (elite) - 06.28S 03.48W|on]] the [[Isle of Souls]], and [[Clue scroll (elite) - 00.35N 35.50E|at]] [[Meiyerditch]], where a Bandosian guard will always appear. The former is a guarantee, while the latter is due to the coordinate's dig spot being too small to fit the Armadylean guard.
